subject: Request: conditional latency band amendment for P2 during CloudWave migration
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Turner <emma@cloudwave.io>, IT Ops <itops@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: conditional latency band amendment for P2 during CloudWave migration

Hi Emma / CloudWave IT team,

Quick note to surface a short request ahead of your scheduled data migration (May 29 22:00 PDT -> May 30 06:00 PDT). We reviewed the migration plan you shared and want to propose a temporary, conditional amendment to the P2 response SLA so we can avoid heavy-handed mitigations that could impact throughput for other tenants. Proposed terms:

- Duration: 8 hours window on 2027-05-29 (22:00 PDT) through 2027-05-30 (06:00 PDT).
- P1: Unchanged (15 min initial response) — Redwood covers full on-call.
- P2: Temporarily allow a conditional latency band of up to 4 hours initial response outside core business hours (22:00–06:00) for the stated window. Normal P2 (60 min) resumes immediately after the window.
- Safeguards: automated routing to fallback model instance + temporary capacity reservation (we'll enable an autoscale policy for the window).
- Monitoring & rollback: we will run an enhanced telemetry check (token-level latency, error rate) with 15‑min alerts. If percent errors > 3% for 30 minutes we automatically rollback routing to the baseline model.
- Credits: If we miss the agreed P1 targets during the window, Redwood will apply a pro-rated credit per our standard SLA terms. For P2 miss during the conditional band, credits are capped at 25% for the window if mitigation steps were followed.

Attached: cw-migration-plan-2027-05.pdf and a draft proposal (proposed-sla-amendment-20270525.docx).

Can you confirm if CloudWave can accept these temporary, conditional terms? If yes, we'll prepare a short DocuSign amendment and schedule the on-call coverage adjustments listed in the attachment.

Thanks — trying to minimize disruption while giving you the buffer needed for migration.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: cw-migration-plan-2027-05.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: proposed-sla-amendment-20270525.docx (docx)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: conditional latency band amendment for P2 during CloudWave migration

Marcus — quick read, looks reasonable. A couple notes before we send to Legal / CloudWave: 

- Add an explicit "circuit breaker" clause: if latency or error thresholds are exceeded we revert traffic to the smaller quantized model and notify both sides.
- Include a short list of what constitutes "mitigation steps followed" so credits trigger only if we followed the fallbacks.
- Recommend we require a 24-hour notice to customers in case the fallback impacts feature parity (brief notice blurb included in draft).

If you want I can add those lines into the draft SLA amendment and loop in Legal, then forward the updated doc to CloudWave. Also we should confirm Ben's proposed on-call changes so Ops is aligned.

— Lauren
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Looping Ops considerations in here. Proposed operational runbook (summary):

1) Pre-window (May 29 18:00 PDT)
   - Reserve burst capacity: +2 reserved GPU workers for CloudWave tenant.
   - Run smoke tests against the migration partition.
2) During window (22:00 -> 06:00)
   - On-call coverage: primary Redwood on-call (P1/P2) remains unchanged for P1. For P2, for the window we add a dedicated engineer from the Enterprise CS rotation (see oncall-rotation-draft.csv attached) monitoring the CloudWave queue.
   - Escalation path: engineer -> oncall lead -> platform SRE -> Marcus (account lead) -> CloudWave ops. Include phone numbers and PagerDuty links.
3) Post-window (06:00 onward)
   - Run a 2-hour health review and capture telemetry snapshot.

Notes: I added a minimal on-call rota to the csv and a short escalation matrix. If CloudWave agrees, we'll: (a) create a temporary PagerDuty service for the window, (b) update routing rules to enable fallback model, and (c) publish the short notice Lauren suggested.

Attachments: oncall-rotation-draft.csv

Ben Carter
Enterprise Support Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Turner <emma@cloudwave.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Ops <itops@cloudwave.io>, CloudWave Legal <legal@cloudwave.io>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: conditional latency band amendment for P2 during CloudWave migration

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the proactive approach. CloudWave is comfortable with the proposed conditional latency band under the following clarifications: 

- We accept the 22:00–06:00 window and the P2 conditional band to 4 hours for that window only.
- Please add the circuit-breaker language Lauren proposed and outline the exact rollback triggers in the doc (percent errors, sustained latency threshold).
- We need the PagerDuty service and escalation contact list at least 48 hours before the start of the window.
- We will sign a one-off amendment via DocuSign; I have asked Legal to review and will route the signed copy back to you by EOD Friday (link attached).

I attached a short signed acknowledgement (DocuSign stub) and our internal migration-runbook excerpt; we'll also share a phone contact for the on-call lead shortly.

Thanks — Emma Turner
Senior IT Program Manager
CloudWave
